Library.description: TC XML import export service library
Library.name: Awp0SoaTCXMLImportExport

ParameterInfo.description: Specifies the TransferMode to which rule file from Dataset needs to be attached.
If true, the operation will be performed in background mode in a separate asynchronous server session; otherwise perform the operation synchronously.

Operation.description:
This operation attaches schema map rule file from the given Dataset to the TransferMode given in the input. Dataset of type Tie0SchemaMap is expected.
A schema map rule file is a comma separated values (CSV) formatted file. It is generated by Advanced Multi-Schema Exhanger application. It is attached as a named reference to Dataset of type Tie0SchemaMap and used later during export/import operation after attaching to the export/import TransferMode.
Operation.name: attachSchemaMapFileToXferMode
Operation.returnDescription:
Errors if any are returned in the ServiceData.
The following errors may be returned:
213003: Unable to create instance of Dispatcher Request.
203421:    Failed to find transfer mode.
9040:        Dataset could not be found.

ParameterInfo.description: Specifies the TransferMode to which rule file from Dataset needs to be attached.

Operation.description:
This asynchronous operation attaches the schema map rule file from the given Dataset of type Tie0SchemaMap to the TransferMode..
A schema map rule file is a comma separated values (CSV) formatted file. It is generated by Advanced Multi-Schema Exhanger application. It is attached as a named reference to Dataset and used later during export/import operation after attaching it to the TransferMode.
Operation.name: attachSchemaMapFileToXferModeAsync
Operation.returnDescription: void: In asynchronous mode void is returned.

Operation.description: Exports the objects to the target site into a briefcase package file (.bcz) in asynchronous mode using the specified Transfer Option Set object and the additional options for scoping data. The export user will be notified with the export resultant data when the export is completed.
Operation.name: exportObjectsToBriefcase
Operation.returnDescription:
The following partial error may be returned:
213003: Unable to create instance of Dispatcher Request.
203408: Transfer Option Set could not be found.
11122: No Multi-Site license (key: multisite_server) is available to export to, or import from, the offline site. Please obtain the license and try again.
11227: The Consumer license "teamcenter_consumer" is not available for the user to export to the offline site.
11098: There are no candidates for synchronization.
11220: An error has occurred when validating the TCXML file (tcxml-file-path). For more information, please check for the "Error Summary" string in the report (report-file-path).

StructElement.description:
The name and value pair options to control the export session behavior. The supported options are:
1. pkgDatasetName: valid values are "Dataset name", specifies the output briefcase Dataset name.
2. revRule: valid values are "Revision Rule name", specifies the Reivsion Rule that will be applied on the root object for configured BOM export.
3. varRule: valid values are "Variant Rule name", specifies the Variant Rule that associated to the root object for configured BOM export.
4. dry_run: valid values are True/False, specifies that the briefcase export report is generated which has discrepancy if any.
5. validateXML: valid values are True/False, specifies that the TCXML is validated against any discrepancy.
6. validateXMLBeforeXslt: valid values are True/False, specifies that the TCXML is validated before mapping is done.
7. modified_objects_only: valid values are True/False, specifies the option for delta export.
8. opt_sync_previous_delta: valid values are True/False, specifies the option for force re-export.
9. OwnershipTransfer: valid values are True/False, specifies the option to do ownership transfer.
10. objsForOwnXfer: valid values are in the format of "<site-id>:<object-uid1,object-uid2…>", specifies the objects for ownership transfer.
11. processUnconfiguredVariants: valid values are True/False, specifies the option to process the BOMLines that are configured out by the Variant Rule.
12. processUnconfiguredByOccEff: valid values are True/False, specifies the option to process the BOMLines that are configured out by Occurrence Effectivity.
13. processSuppressedOcc: valid values are True/False, specifies the option to process the suppressed BOMLines.
14. processUnconfiguredChanges: valid values are True/False, specifies the option to process the BOMLines that are configured out by Incremental Change.
15. ContinueOnError: valid values are True/False, specifies the option to continue the export on partial error.
StructElement.name: sessionOptions
